name: NHBM Community Summer Sailing Programs
operator_name: New Hampshire Boat Museum (with Wolfeboro Parks and Recreation Department)
description_short: Sailing lessons for kids and adults, run by the New Hampshire Boat Museum with Wolfeboro Parks and Recreation. Youth start in Optimist dinghies at Albee Beach on Lake Wentworth in Wolfeboro, and keelboat classes for ages 16 and up are held at 19 Mile Bay on Lake Winnipesaukee in Tuftonboro.
swim_waterfront_notes: Lake-based. Youth and adult dinghy classes are at Albee Beach on Lake Wentworth (Wolfeboro). Keelboat classes are at 19 Mile Bay on Lake Winnipesaukee (Tuftonboro), taught by US Sailing-certified instructors. The source gives no swim test or life jacket rules.

warnings: This is a press release from the museum's Press Room, not the program's schedule or registration page.
The release is dated April 28, 2026 and covers summer 2026, which has already passed (today is 2026-10-13). No 2027 information is shown.
The page lists no dates, prices or youth ages. The only age given is 16+ for keelboat classes.
The program is open to all ages, including adults, so it is not a children's camp only.
The two museum addresses (Moultonborough and Wolfeboro) are not where sailing takes place. Classes are at Albee Beach (Wolfeboro) and 19 Mile Bay (Tuftonboro).
The 'Tickets & Registration' Peek link is a booking link for the whole site. It is not confirmed to be the sailing registration page, so it was left out.
